scope: Microscopic synthetic-template feasibility preflight ONLY. Not spontaneous-origin search, adaptive evolution, or digital life; do not plant templates in later unbiased M8.1 discovery.

model.lattice: closed rectangular 10 x 5; single occupancy/cell; at most two horizontal backbone B bonds/monomer, at most two vertical weak H interactions/monomer; physically distinct B vs H valence
model.materials: two monomer species 0/1; finite bath initially 40 of EACH species; particles added only by consuming corresponding bath units; particle IDs persistent and never reused
model.energy: integer available energy initially 500 + preexisting laboratory template B stored energies; each background adsorption dissipates 1; each H capture consumes 2 (one dissipated plus one H stored); B bond formation consumes 2 (1 dissipated plus 1 stored); spontaneous H release dissipates its stored 1; B break refunds stored energy 1. No external injection; exact available + bond stores + dissipated = initial total.
model.native_laws: new M8 local stochastic reactions ONLY; original M6 fixed population physics remains unchanged; no global fitness and no clone instruction. Horizontal B creation between adjacent free-valence particles; if both B-candidate monomers have separate vertically adjacent H partners whose B is present, raise B formation probability; otherwise baseline B rate.
model.template_contact: A first monomer may recruit a monomer from bath into a vertical neighboring empty cell when it currently has >=1 horizontal B bond and free H valence. Reaction probability independent of source bit (p_capture=0.55), while acquired monomer's species is selected by local chemical affinity: match source bit with probability 0.90, mismatch 0.10; H contact stores energy 1 and may detach. Competing monomer capture is kinetic/energetic, not a copy() instruction.

control_modes.templated: recruited monomer preferentially matches physical adjacent bonded monomer species
control_modes.shuffled_identity: for each capture location, use independently hashed pseudo-template identity unrelated to physical source species; same aggregate capture attempt rate, physical H count and energetic costs, and same pair-keyed stochastic draws. This is information-channel-scrambled rate-matched placebo, not a no-contact control.
control_modes.no_template: disable template-mediated adsorption, retains optional background reactions; with fixture p_background=0 expected no additional monomers
control_modes.unpowered: set available energy to 0, leave stored bonds, no adsorption and no backbone creation

model.random: Counter-based deterministic draws keyed by (seed,tick,chemistry-step,x,y,lane) independent of event count. Exact same random draws between genotype-edit forks and between active-vs-scrambled control.
model.time: Order each tick: weak H release, backbone B break, local adsorption/capture, backbone B formation, ledger validation; no seed adaptation based on observed outcomes.
model.geometry_limitation: This is intentionally an anisotropic 1D horizontal polymer lattice embedded in 2D, with vertical H contacts. It is a simplification, NOT a physical universal artificial chemistry. Monomers are stationary once captured; no open-ended organism behavior.

controls.seeds: 32 fixed paired synthetic laboratory template fixtures, integers 50001..50032, no selection or retries
controls.artificial_template: Explicitly plant only a four-monomer B-bonded artificial polymer at x=3,4,5,6, y=1, sequence 0101. This is NOT spontaneous origin; only a software positive control.
controls.edit: Genotype-edit a single parent material bit at x=5,y=1 (0101 -> 0111) without moving material or changing energy or bath inventory. Compare first genuinely reaction-captured monomer identity at exact neighbor x=5,y=2 across identical paired seeds, no manufactured daughter.
controls.fixed_product_observer: At y=2,x3..x6, native-formed material IDs distinct from all original parent IDs; contiguous three real B bonds, no H tether to original parent and persisted >=20 consecutive ticks during 120 steps; sequence must be read from the actually adsorbed species. Observer never creates molecules.

preregistered_minimums.physical_integrity: 32/32 templates keep exact particle + bath mass and energy ledger each tick; no native M6 file change; full identical same-seed repeat hash
preregistered_minimums.causal_edit: At least 20/32 paired edit controls change the species of the FIRST captured actual daughter-position monomer at (5,2) in templated mode; in shuffled_identity with the identical paired seed the edit must change species 0/32 times. All physical x5,y2 capture events must be true local adsorption events.
preregistered_minimums.product: At least 8/32 templated starting 0101 fixtures produce a complete detached and at-least-20-tick-persistent exact matching sequence 0101 polymer at y2 x3..x6, and at least 5 MORE exact matching products than scrambled-identity mode (same resources and reaction rate). No positive discovery claim from this artificial fixture.
preregistered_minimums.no_template: With p_background=0, no_template control must make 0 extra material particles over 120 ticks; with unavailable energy, unpowered makes 0 extra particles; any failures STOP.

controls.stopping: If any gate fails, record not_met and do NOT start unbiased seed search; DO NOT lower thresholds after examining data.
controls.research_limit: Even passing is evidence of an implemented designed information-bearing local reaction, not spontaneous generation of an organism. Spontaneous origin is a separate heldout M8.1 gate; heritable 3-generation lineages and functional metabolism are separately required.
